scope: whole cell extracts were immuno-precipitated (IP) with anti-GFP antibodies and pellets were subjected to quantitative mass-spectrometry analysis

Each extract was then incubated with 50 µl of GFP-Trap beads (gta-20, Chromotek) for 75 min at 4 °C, washed five times with lysis buffer, and beads from the different isotopic conditions were finally pooled. Bound proteins were eluted by adding 1% SDS to the beads and boiling for 10 min.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on the interactome of GFP-tagged RPAP3-Cter and its mutants using SILAC and affinity purification (IP) from HeLa cell extracts. While whole cell extracts were the starting material, the material actually analyzed by MS was the affinity-purified complex.
